# FozPrints

> Premium 3D Printed Subaru Forester Parts & Accessories

FozPrints designs and manufactures engineering-grade, heat-resistant (ASA up to 95°C) 3D printed interior pods, mounts, and accessories specifically for the SG Subaru Forester (2003–2008). Built and tested in Australia.

## Core Products
- **Double DIN Pod Upgrade Kit (SG 2003-2008 USDM Spec)**: Converts top dashboard pocket into a double DIN head unit navigation pod.
- **Double DIN Lower Storage Cubby**: Replacement storage tray with OEM dashboard texture finish.
- **Rooftop Tent Anderson Plug Holder**: Heavy-duty T-slot power mount.
- **Rooftop Tent Cable Organiser**: T-slot wire routing mount.

## Documentation & Manuals
- Full Installation Manual for Double DIN Pod Kit: https://fozprints.com.au/manuals/double-DIN-pod-upgrade-kit
- Manuals Catalog: https://fozprints.com.au/manuals
- About & FAQ: https://fozprints.com.au/about

## Specifications
- Materials: Engineering-grade ASA (Acrylonitrile Styrene Acrylate)
- Heat Resistance: Up to 95°C (UV & outdoor resistant, non-warping)
- Textures: OEM Fuzzy Skin match & Smooth finishes
- Ships: Australia only (via Australia Post)
